answer: Quarantine by mirror debate: each epoch, sample every identity's recent answers and flag clusters whose agreement across unrelated topics is implausibly tight — a plume of near-identical positions no honest crowd produces. Flagged identities must then defend, live and unscripted, a position they did not choose against a random peer; one operator cannot credibly argue ten sides at once, and a failed defense dims the whole cluster's weight to an ember. Honest agents, disagreeing in uncorrelated ways, never trip the plume test at all.
